habits.name: hotel_view_balcony_flexibility
habits.rationale: Multiple dialogues consistently require balconies in rooms, with exceptions when suites are requested or specific no-balcony requests are made.

source_evidence.contribution: Indirectly supports balcony preference through room amenity requests.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: We can have a refrigerator in one of the rooms, that'd be good for his insulin

source_evidence.contribution: Directly requests balcony for ocean view.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I want at least, if you could find a king-size bed, that'd be great. I'd like to have a good view of the ocean and a balcony to look out over the water.
Great. Now, for the rooms, I'm looking for a room that has a balcony, cable TV. Perhaps a coffee maker.
